parsed.note_claim: The account belongs to an individual who falsely impersonates retired wrestling personalities and is not the real Bob Holly.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: There's a fake Bob Holly account making the rounds on Twitter... The same account has a track record of impersonation, having previously pretended to be Sid Vicious before quietly rebranding after Sid's death.
